f77369cf: What is the name of Solo Leveling's protagonist?
Sung Jinwoo is Solo Leveling's protagonist — known as “the world's weakest hunter” (E-rank), he is the only one to receive the System after the Double Dungeon and gradually becomes the most powerful.
f82d1690: What is Sung Jinwoo's starting rank among hunters?
Sung Jinwoo starts at E-rank — the lowest possible, considered by everyone the weakest hunter. His unofficial title is in fact “the world's weakest hunter”.
fa3c093b: What is the name of the S-rank huntress who grows close to Sung Jinwoo?
Cha Hae-In is an S-rank huntress known for her magical sense of smell — she can sense hunters' mana. She develops feelings for Jinwoo and becomes a central figure.
927157a1: Who is Yoo Jinho in Solo Leveling?
A rich kid D-rank hunter who becomes vice president of Jinwoo's guild
The head of the Hunter Association
Yoo Jinho, a D-rank hunter and son of a major guild's owner, becomes Jinwoo's loyal right-hand man and vice president of the Ahjin Guild.
4d246314: Who is Thomas Andre in Solo Leveling?
An American S-rank hunter from the Scavenger Guild
The head of the world Hunter Association
Thomas Andre is the strongest S-rank hunter in the United States — master of the Scavenger Guild. He is considered one of the five most powerful National Level Hunters in the world.
dadebbfa: The chairman of the Korean Hunter Association
Go Gunhee is the chairman of the Korean Hunter Association — a father figure who believes in Jinwoo from the start. A former hunter himself, he embodies integrity and justice.
29e28367: What is Sung Jinwoo's true title once his powers are revealed?
Jinwoo is the Shadow Monarch — the title held by Ashborn, the being who passes his powers on to him. He is the most powerful shadow user in the Solo Leveling universe.
79b9f85d: What is the name of Sung Jinwoo's missing father?
Sung Il-Hwan is Jinwoo's father — a hunter who mysteriously disappeared in a dungeon. His return and his link to the Rulers are a major turning point in the story.
8b588611: What is the name of Sung Jinwoo's sister?
Sung Jinah is Jinwoo's younger sister — one of his main motivations. He works hard to make sure she lacks nothing, especially while their mother is in the hospital.
ea7ffa58: Who is Ashborn in Solo Leveling?
The original Shadow Monarch, who chooses Jinwoo as his successor
The first hunter to get the System
Ashborn is the original Shadow Monarch — a being of colossal power who chose Sung Jinwoo as his successor. He is the ultimate source of Jinwoo's powers.
26301153: Which Korean S-rank hunter is called “the strongest in Korea”?
Choi Jong-In is an S-rank hunter considered Korea's strongest before Jinwoo's rise — master of the Hunters Guild, he embodies the traditional elite of the hunter world.
89893105: What is the “System” in Solo Leveling?
A secret government controlling the dungeons
A game-like interface only Jinwoo can see, letting him level up
The System is an invisible interface only Jinwoo can perceive — like a role-playing game. It gives him quests, levels and skills, letting him progress without limit, unlike other hunters.
ec3a4cbc: Which incident lets Jinwoo receive the System?
An attack by a jealous hunter

The Double Dungeon incident is the starting point — Jinwoo and other low-rank hunters are trapped in a dungeon far more dangerous than expected. Left for dead, Jinwoo receives the System and “reawakens”.
35479f8c: What is the power that lets Jinwoo create soldiers from enemies' bodies called?
Shadow Extraction lets Jinwoo create shadow soldiers from the bodies of defeated enemies — his army can reach thousands of soldiers, each keeping the original monster's abilities.
0995a5e7: What is the name of Jinwoo's first and most loyal shadow knight?
Igris, the red knight, is one of Jinwoo's first shadow soldiers. Defeated during the Job Change Quest, he then serves him with absolute loyalty.
45587f42: Which shadow soldier comes from the Ant King?
Beru is extracted from the Ant King after the Jeju Island arc — one of the most epic fights in the webtoon. Beru becomes one of the most powerful generals of Jinwoo's shadow army.
18cab9a4: What is a “penalty quest” in Jinwoo's System?
A bonus quest with better rewards
A forced quest with a severe punishment if not completed
The penalty quest is imposed by the System — if Jinwoo fails to complete his daily quest in time, he is teleported to a dangerous penalty zone. This forces constant progress.
e93a87a2: Which ability lets Jinwoo become invisible?
Stealth is the skill that lets Jinwoo hide himself — making his presence undetectable to other hunters and monsters. It is a crucial technique in his strategies.
687bc13f: How many ranks are there in the hunter ranking system?
6: S, A, B, C, D, E
The system has 6 ranks: S (the highest), A, B, C, D and E (the lowest). Jinwoo starts at E-rank and, thanks to the System, rises far beyond the classic S-rank.
5806b80d: What are the evil beings who want to destroy humanity in Solo Leveling called?
The Monarchs, rulers of the monsters, want to wipe out humanity. They are opposed by the Rulers, beings of light.
63a92ca2: Who are the Rulers in Solo Leveling?
The best hunters in the world
Beings of light opposed to the Monarchs
The Rulers are beings of light who have been at war with the Monarchs since time immemorial.
2ab29553: What happens when a dungeon is not cleared in time in Solo Leveling?
Its monsters break out and invade the city
If a dungeon is not cleared in time, a “dungeon break” occurs: the monsters come out of the gate and attack the city.
03928c34: What is the name of the guild Jinwoo creates with Yoo Jinho?
The Ahjin Guild is the guild Jinwoo creates with Yoo Jinho as vice president — it rises spectacularly and is soon seen as one of the most powerful in Korea.
eb336b0b: Which anime studio produced the Solo Leveling anime in 2024?
A-1 Pictures produced the Solo Leveling anime (2024) — hugely anticipated by fans of the webtoon, it largely lived up to expectations with a high-quality production.
dfc4d3cf: What is Sung Jinwoo's final fate at the conclusion of Solo Leveling?
As Shadow Monarch, he turns back time to save humanity
He founds a new hunter organization
After defeating the Monarchs, Jinwoo uses the Cup of Reincarnation to turn back time and give everyone a life in which the disaster never happened.
6689aad6: How does Beru communicate with Jinwoo after his extraction?
He learns to speak and becomes one of the most expressive soldiers
He does not communicate and obeys silently
Beru stands out among the shadow soldiers because he can talk — he expresses emotions and loyalty, and becomes the most endearing and distinctive shadow in Jinwoo's army.
1700d876: What is the Jeju Island arc and why is it crucial?
Liberating an island overrun by giant mutant ants
An attack on the Korean government
Discovering a portal to another dimension
The Jeju Island arc is the crisis of the island overrun by giant mutant ants — Jinwoo faces the Ant King in an epic fight. Victory lets him extract Beru, a turning point in his power.
d4dcf0bb: Mandatory daily training that gradually strengthens Jinwoo's body
A challenge against a specific monster
The Daily Quest is a daily workout imposed by the System — if Jinwoo completes it, he gains stats. It is the basis of his continuous physical development.
a5a368c3: Which country is the main setting of Solo Leveling?
Solo Leveling mainly takes place in South Korea — Seoul is the central city. Korean society and its hunter system are the heart of the story, with trips to other countries.
7d9adba4: Who is the author of the original Solo Leveling story?
Chugong is the writer of Solo Leveling (Na Honjaman Rebel-eop) — Dubu (Jang Sung-Rak) is the webtoon's artist. The webtoon was published on KakaoPage from 2018 to 2021.
2a16e715: What is the condition of Jinwoo's mother at the start of the story?
She is in an endless sleep caused by a mana-related illness
Jinwoo's mother suffers from Eternal Sleep, a mana-related illness that keeps her asleep. Paying for her hospital care is Jinwoo's first motivation.
e5597aa7: What official title does the System give Jinwoo?

The System refers to Jinwoo simply as “the Player” — a direct reference to the video game mechanics behind his abilities. The title sums up how unique his situation is compared with every other hunter.
d67ce7a2: What role does Jinwoo's shadow soldier Bellion hold?
Grand Marshal of his shadow army
Bellion is the Grand Marshal of Jinwoo's shadow army — the commander-in-chief of his soldiers, a legendary figure in the lore of the Shadow Monarch.
3fc4504e: What is the relationship between Cha Hae-In and Jinwoo at the end of the story?
Cha Hae-In and Jinwoo end up together and marry. She is one of the few people who see the human behind his power.
a3801c5a: How does Jinwoo's quest to save his hospitalized mother end?
Thanks to the Elixir of Life obtained in the Demon Castle
Jinwoo climbs the Demon Castle to gather the ingredients for the Elixir of Life, which finally wakes his mother.
e4807c0d: Who draws the Solo Leveling webtoon?
The webtoon is drawn by Dubu, of studio Redice, based on Chugong's story.
62ab6923: In what form was Solo Leveling first published?
Solo Leveling was first a Korean web novel by Chugong (2016), before being adapted as a webtoon in 2018.
0d502fc0: On which Korean platform was the Solo Leveling webtoon published?
The webtoon was published on KakaoPage from 2018 to 2021 and became a worldwide phenomenon.
b5c7eda5: Which word does Jinwoo say to turn a defeated enemy into a shadow soldier?
By saying “Arise”, Jinwoo extracts a defeated enemy's shadow and makes it a soldier in his army.
079a9dc7: Which class does Jinwoo get by completing his Job Change Quest?
After the Job Change Quest, Jinwoo becomes a Necromancer (Shadow Monarch), which gives him the power to extract shadows.
4e4279a9: Which creature does the shadow soldier Tank come from?
The leader of an ice bear tribe
Tank is the leader of the ice bears, defeated in a red gate dungeon.
d068c3f9: Who became the shadow soldier Iron?
Iron is the shadow of Kim Chul, an A-rank hunter from the White Tiger Guild who had tried to kill Jinwoo.
fc88e8f5: Which flying shadow soldier serves as Jinwoo's mount?
Kaisel is the shadow of the wyvern ridden by the demon king Baran, defeated in the Demon Castle. It becomes Jinwoo's mount.
4442d935: Which enemy does the shadow soldier Tusk come from?
Tusk is the shadow of Kargalgan, a great orc shaman who mastered magic.
413899e1: What happens when a gate turns red?
The hunters are trapped until the boss is defeated
A red gate closes on the hunters: they cannot leave until they defeat the boss, and time passes differently inside.
1869e959: Which guild does Cha Hae-In belong to before growing close to Jinwoo?
Cha Hae-In is vice master of the Hunters Guild, led by Choi Jong-In.
b2e57553: What is the name of Jinwoo and Cha Hae-In's son?
At the end of the story, Jinwoo and Cha Hae-In have a son, Sung Suho, the hero of the sequel “Solo Leveling: Ragnarok”.
31079623: Which Monarch, king of dragons, is called the Monarch of Destruction?
Antares, the Monarch of Destruction, is the king of dragons and the most powerful of the enemy Monarchs.
ef31d465: Who designed the System that makes Jinwoo progress?
The System was designed by the Architect, a being created to prepare a vessel for the Shadow Monarch's powers.
c8a2d465: Who composes the music for the Solo Leveling anime?
Hiroyuki Sawano, composer for Attack on Titan, scores the Solo Leveling anime.
b592a522: In what year did the Solo Leveling anime start airing?
A-1 Pictures' anime adaptation began in January 2024. Season 2, “Arise from the Shadow”, followed in 2025.
fd80471d: Which shadow comes from an S-rank hunter of the Scavenger Guild?
Greed is the shadow of Hwang Dongsoo, an S-rank hunter from the Scavenger Guild.
